technical.lead: Civil-society coalition opens FMRB executive order public-comment fight
technical.body: A coordinated Friday pushback lands on the Wednesday Frontier Model Review Board interagency draft. AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file a joint open letter to OSTP and the White House Counsel arguing that any pre-release notification regime relying on Defense Production Act Section 708 voluntary information-sharing authority — without an Administrative Procedure Act notice-and-comment window — is vulnerable to State Farm arbitrary-and-capricious review the moment a denied or delayed deployment lands in the DC Circuit. Senators Mark Warner (Senate Intel) and Todd Young (Commerce) jointly request a classified briefing from NIST and the ODNI cyber lead on the threshold methodology before any final EO signs, tentatively scheduled for May 15. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google DeepMind publish brief statements supporting a comment window in principle while declining to oppose the Section 708 vehicle, holding the cohort consensus the May 7 reciprocity protocol relied on.

technical.lead: Cerebras opens at 151 dollars on Nasdaq, +18.3% over IPO price
technical.body: Cerebras Systems opens for trading on Nasdaq under ticker CBRS at $151.40, +18.3% over the $128 IPO price, briefly touching $158.20 intraday before settling near $148 at close on volume of approximately 28M shares. Fully-diluted market cap closes near $31.4B, putting the company about 18% above its original $26.6B target on day one. OpenAI's $1B warrant package now marks at roughly $4.9B paper gain at the close-of-day reference; lock-up expires October 2026 (180 days). Buyside notes from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and Citi initiate Buy ratings with $165-$185 12-month price targets that explicitly cite the April 2026 OpenAI 1GW first-data-center commitment plus the still-undisclosed Saudi Aramco Digital MoU as upside drivers. The first-day pop becomes the operative reference for the SambaNova, Groq, and Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind it. Cerebras simultaneously unveils the next-generation CS-4 wafer-scale engine targeting 71 PFLOPS dense BF16 with first engineering-sample shipments in Q1 2027.

technical.lead: Day-eight Ni8mare scans show 41% drop after KEV listing, 4.8x exploit spike
technical.body: Shadowserver and Censys publish day-eight scans on n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare). Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances drop from approximately 14,200 to 8,300 (-41.5% in 24 hours) following the CISA KEV-catalog addition, with the steepest drops in Germany (1,920 to 980) and France (880 to 410). Roughly 47% of remaining exposed instances are still unpatched. Censys honeypot telemetry observes a 4.8x spike in exploitation attempts on the n8n REST webhook entry point during the first 12 hours after KEV listing, consistent with opportunistic scanning by commodity-tier exploit kits now incorporating the public PoC. NHS England issues a separate emergency advisory naming Ni8mare among an enumerated list of agentic-AI workflow-platform CVEs that block migration into the NHS Federated Data Platform technology estate. Two additional agentic-AI tooling-stack CVEs land 24 hours after the LangGraph + LiteLLM disclosure pair: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7, deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated path-traversal).

technical.lead: Three hyperscalers ship managed agent-registry tiers within 24 hours
technical.body: Hyperscaler-managed registry tier announcements land within 24 hours of the dual Anthropic + OpenAI launch. Microsoft Azure AI Foundry announces a managed Skill Catalog with signed-skill registration, version-pinning, and per-tenant capability gating that integrates with the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry plus the OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry. AWS Bedrock announces an Agent Registry preview with FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance from the Bedrock Government partition. Google Cloud Vertex AI announces Agent Governance Center entering public preview with an expanded model-card schema covering signed-skill provenance plus per-tenant Mythos-class gating. The three-vendor parallel landing inside 24 hours pulls the May 7 Anthropic + OpenAI registry shape into the hyperscaler procurement perimeter ahead of the Q4 2026 enterprise-RFP cycle. Anthropic separately publishes Claude Code 3.0 day-one telemetry: 11,400 skills published and 612K skill installs in the first 24 hours, with 87% of skills installed via per-tenant capability-gating workflow rather than ad-hoc copy-paste, and 38 enterprise customers including JPMorgan Chase, Booz Allen Hamilton, Mandiant Consulting, and Raytheon enabling per-tenant Mythos Preview gating under the new contractual ethics-and-misuse rider.

technical.lead: Router-Only LoRA arxiv preprint formalizes 71-78% accuracy at 11-16% VRAM
technical.body: Unsloth ships a Hugging Face joint paper plus three follow-on fine-tuning recipes. The arxiv preprint Router-Only LoRA for Mixture-of-Experts Models presents the formal evaluation behind the May 7 Qwen3.6-Max router-only training mode, reporting ablation across Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, and Kimi K2.6. Router-only LoRA recovers 71-78% of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy across the four models at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM. New recipes ship for Llama 4 Behemoth-class router-only tuning (target H100 + B200 single-node), Kimi K2.6 router-only on RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier (96GB VRAM), and Mixtral 8x22B router-only adaptation for sovereign-cloud customers requiring no Hugging Face dependency at inference time. DeepMind publishes a same-day companion arxiv paper, Stable Long-Context Reinforcement Learning via Router-Aware Advantage Decomposition, showing that decomposing the policy-gradient advantage along Mixture-of-Experts router-decision boundaries materially improves training stability for context lengths beyond 128K tokens, recovering full-LoRA-on-experts effective gradient signal in router-only mode and explicitly citing the Unsloth + Hugging Face evaluation as the base setup.
